headline: Names the VA clinic in Gallup, New Mexico, the Hiroshi "Hershey" Miyamura VA Clinic.
what_it_does: This law officially names the Department of Veterans Affairs clinic in Gallup, New Mexico, as the Hiroshi "Hershey" Miyamura Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic, or the Hiroshi "Hershey" Miyamura VA Clinic for short.
